Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • Faster address suggestions. Typing a recipient no longer slows the app down, and you can keep typing or deleting while suggestions are showing. Use ↑/↓ and Return to pick one, or Esc to dismiss.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Images are hidden until you allow them. Remote images let senders see when you open their email, so they now stay hidden. Use Load Images on a message, Always from a sender you trust, or switch to Always in Settings › General › Privacy.
  • Sign-in links and codes. Sign-in and verification emails show the code and the link at the top of the message, with Copy and Open buttons. New-mail notifications get Open Link and Copy Link too. The link's website is always shown.
  • Menu bar icon. See your unread count from the menu bar, open recent unread mail, write a new message or check for mail. Turn it off in Settings › General.
  • All Starred. With more than one account, see starred mail from every account in one place, under All Inboxes.

Security

  • Scripts inside emails no longer run, and an email can no longer redirect the reading pane to a web page.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • What's New. See what changed in each update from Help › What's New in Normal Mail. It also opens once by itself after Normal Mail updates.
